name: Joacim
description: High priest in Jerusalem; wrote to the people of Bethulia and Betomestham charging them to keep the passages of the hill country against the Assyrians; with the ancients of Israel commanded the people, stood before the Lord with the priests offering the daily burnt offerings in sackcloth and ashes during the siege, and afterward came with the ancients of Israel from Jerusalem to see Judith and bless her for what God had done

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
